pages.lesson:
LESSON: GOOD GROOMING PRACTICES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Hygiene Practices
Topic 3.1: Good Grooming Practices

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Good Grooming Practices
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Good Grooming Practices
2. give Kenyan examples of Good Grooming Practices
3. practise a safe skill for Good Grooming Practices

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Good Grooming Practices

Teach
• Observe Good Grooming Practices in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Good Grooming Practices (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Good Grooming Practices.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Good Grooming Practices.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Good Grooming Practices.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Good Grooming Practices.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Good Grooming Practices: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Good Grooming Practices with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
